name: ICI Homes — Serena at Mosaic
heroBody: This is your Serena kitchen at Mosaic with real upgrade selections wired up. Buyers pick finishes and see them in the room.
photoBaseline: Open-concept kitchen in the ICI Homes Serena model. White shaker-style cabinets on perimeter walls — tall pantry-height cabinets on right side, standard upper and lower cabinets on back wall with stainless steel French-door refrigerator on left and built-in microwave and wall oven on right. Wood-tone stained island base with white quartz marble-look countertops with subtle veining on both perimeter and island. Mosaic/herringbone pattern tile backsplash between upper cabinets and countertops on back wall, lit by under-cabinet lighting. Large format beige/cream tile flooring throughout. Dark oil-rubbed bronze bar-pull hardware on all cabinet doors and drawers. Black gooseneck faucet on island sink. Two geometric cage pendant lights with wood accents hanging over island. Greige/taupe walls visible above cabinets and on vaulted ceiling area. Recessed can lights in ceiling. Four upholstered barstools at island near side (staging). Staging items on island: place settings with desserts. View through to hallway and front entry with chandelier visible on left side of frame. Decorative vases and art on top of tall cabinets.
spatialHint: PERIMETER CABINETS (kitchen-cabinet-color): White shaker cabinets on the back wall and right wall. Back wall has standard upper/lower cabinets flanking the refrigerator and range hood area. Right wall has tall floor-to-ceiling pantry-height cabinets. These are all the SAME color, separate from the island. ISLAND BASE (kitchen-island-cabinet-color): The center island base is a DIFFERENT color from perimeter cabinets. Currently a wood-tone stain. Only the island base panels and doors change with this selection, not the perimeter cabinets. COUNTERTOPS (counter-top): White quartz marble-look with subtle veining, continuous on both perimeter counters and island top. Same material everywhere. BACKSPLASH (backsplash): Mosaic/herringbone tile on the back wall between upper cabinets and perimeter countertops, illuminated by under-cabinet LED strips. FLOORING (main-area-flooring-color): Large format beige tile visible around island base and under barstools in the lower portion of frame. PAINT (common-wall-paint): Greige/taupe visible on walls above the tall cabinets and in the vaulted ceiling area above the island. PRESERVE: Stainless appliances (French-door fridge left of back wall, built-in microwave and wall oven on right wall). Dark oil-rubbed bronze bar-pull hardware on all cabinets. Black gooseneck faucet. Two geometric cage pendant lights over island.

spatialHints.kitchen-island-cabinet-color: island cabinet doors and drawer fronts only

insights.label: Upgrade attachment when buyers see selections in the room
Appointment time spent explaining what things look like

closingLine: Confident buyers pick faster and spend more.
